column2: God's call is what God summons a person to do or to become; to turn from it is to turn from someone who calls, not only from a circumstance.
God's work is what God has made, as distinct from what a creature makes of it; each person is among it.
To return toward one from whom one had turned is to turn back toward him and leave that turning; it does not restore the state before the turning, for the turning has been lived through.
